translation: Porque ⟨está⟩ postrada ⟨al⟩ polvo ⟨la⟩ vida ⟨que está en⟩ nuestras entrañas; ⟨la⟩ vida ⟨de⟩ nuestro vientre ⟨está⟩ adherida ⟨a⟩ ⟨la⟩ tierra.

tokens.rationale: שחה means 'to sink down' or 'be bowed down' — rendered with implied estar (to be) for Spanish
The preposition ל (to/for) with עפר (dust) — Spanish article 'al' required
נפש is breath/life-force, not just 'soul'; the נוּ (our) suffix shown with 'nuestras entrañas' for contextual clarity
דבקה means 'to cling' or 'adhere' — rendered with implied estar (to be) for Spanish
The preposition ל (to/for) with ארץ (earth) — Spanish articles required
בטן means belly/womb; the נוּ (our) suffix rendered as 'nuestro vientre', with 'vida' added to connect to previous נפש
